title: Christmas Tree Playdough Counting to 12 — Fine Motor Freebie

overview.description: Christmas-themed playdough counting mats for numbers 1-12. Children use playdough to create ornaments/decorations on Christmas tree illustrations, matching the target number. Combines fine motor (rolling, placing playdough) with counting practice. Seasonal theme.

notes: TPT link expired. Second playdough mat in the collection (pairs with compound words playdough mats). Aless values playdough as a multi-sensory learning tool — combines fine motor with academic content.
